nix.description: Off by default in Renovate; reads the flake inputs in flake.nix

pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate; bumps the hook `rev:` pins in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

lockFileMaintenance.description: `nix flake update` for flake.lock — the nix manager only moves inputs whose ref changed, so without this the pinned revisions never refresh.

customManagers.description: Track version pins in the Nix let bindings annotated with `# renovate: ...` comments: the MCP server and npm pins under nix/, and the tycswap release in flake.nix (a bump there fails checks.tycswap until its hashes follow).

packageRules.description: A third-party release pin is never automerged: nothing else vouches for an unreviewed upstream release. The 14-day hold gives a fresh tag time to be pulled or re-cut.
